product_metadata.title: Stritra - 3D Skull Silicone Jello Ice Mold Flexible Cube Maker Tray for Halloween and Christmas Party. Best for Whiskey and Cocktails
features: Novelty Idea - Putting this giant skull into your drinks is fun and joyful. And it is great for halloween christmas, summer pool parties, restuarants and bars. Best for gift.
For Most drinks - This big head melt slowly and keep your drink cool, best for cocktails and whisky. It can also use for iced tea, coffee, soda drink, fresh juice, fruit punch and even iced water
More Than a Ice Mold - this is not just a jello ice cube maker, it also for jello, chocolate or even soap mould
Food Grade Silicone - With wide temperature range (-40°C~230°C). It is non toxic, BPA Free. Safe to use in refrigerator, dishwasher, oven and microwave.

User Tips - A boiled water or distilled water are better than tap water for making a perfect crystal clear 3D ice cube, no matter you making ice ball or square cube. Down below to description to see my person experience making 4 giant skull
